notes.title: Tutorial incoming
notes.content:
Hello, I will be adding a structured level that will ease you into the game before you go in and slay some zombies. I will get on this level in the upcoming days and will be released. 

Happy slaying!!

notes.title: Retry crashing fix
notes.content:
Retry had a bug that would crash the game. 

I fixed by removing the retry button and menu button and having it auto load the game again until you pause the game and use the menu button from there.

Sorry for these bugs I overlooked most of my buttons and worked on gameplay as much as I could. 

Happy slaying.

notes.title: Pause menu fix - Going to menu
notes.content:
When you go to the menu it would crash the game. This is due to having the game load out of a large level. 

This would be a polishing issue / older unity version issue. my apologies.

The game should be in a playable state now. Just a few issues I didn't look at.

Happy Slaying.

notes.title: Crash fix 1.01 Update
notes.content:
1 - Change the way the levels load

Thank you for using the Report bug since I am an only developer I can test so much within my ability.

and
